capabilities: Detect when the cursor enters or leaves a math formula area
Switch to an English input method inside formulas
Restore the previous input method when leaving formulas
Configure the switching commands and input method identifiers
extras: Default configuration is macOS-only; users on other operating systems must supply their own command-line input method switching tools in settings.
motivation: The README says switching automatically is done "to improve writing efficiency" when writing mathematical formulas.
problem: Writers using non-English input methods (like CJK IMEs) have to switch manually every time they type a math formula between $ symbols.

requires.name: macism (macOS) or an equivalent input method switching CLI

summary: Input method switcher that toggles to English input when the cursor enters a math formula and restores the previous input method on exit.
